SoftBank agrees to acquire the Robotics and AI Institute

The reported agreement would bring Marc Raibert’s research institute into SoftBank’s robotics portfolio, subject to review.

The Robot Report ↗18 September 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2Videos 1

An agreement still under review

The Robot Report says SoftBank agreed to buy the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai. Financial terms were not disclosed. The transaction was undergoing CFIUS review, with the precise review status unclear at the time of reporting.

Marc Raibert’s research institute

Based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, RAI was founded in 2022 with more than $400 million in initial investment from Hyundai. Its work spans control, perception, manipulation, navigation and AI for physical tasks.

An existing relationship in robotics

Marc Raibert founded both Boston Dynamics and RAI. SoftBank owned Boston Dynamics from 2017 to 2021 before Hyundai acquired a controlling stake, connecting the organisations through a longer history in robotics.

Questions that remain open

Raibert’s role after a completed deal was unclear. The report suggests RAI’s research could complement SoftBank’s robotics and AI portfolio, but the outcome still depends on approval and subsequent implementation.
